versions.changelog:
- Initial release of jf-open-pro-algo-detection skill.
- Provides interactive guidance to clarify detection scenarios, recommending appropriate algorithms from 52 non-database-required algorithm options.
- Supports analyzing local images, image URLs, or camera snapshots (with jf-open-pro-capture skill) and generating structured detection reports.
- Full workflow implemented: scene clarification, algorithm recommendation, user confirmation, credential check, algorithm enabling/calling, and structured result interpretation.
- API calls and credential management handled exclusively via the provided Python scripts; no direct HTTP requests required.
- Detailed setup and troubleshooting instructions included for both image and camera device use cases.
